title: A log analyser with regex
description:
Read server log lines and summarise them with regular expressions.

```
1,240 lines, 1,198 understood, 42 skipped
errors: 17 (top: "disk full" x9, "timeout" x5)
busiest minute: 14:03 (88 requests)
slowest request: /api/report 2,310 ms
```
hints: `(?<time>\\d{2}:\\d{2}):\\d{2} (?<level>INFO|WARN|ERROR) (?<method>\\w+) (?<path>\\S+) (?<status>\\d{3}) (?<ms>\\d+)ms(?: (?<msg>.*))?` covers the format (lesson 8.01). The capital `\S` is the opposite of `\s`: any character that is not a space.
Group by the time with `Collectors.groupingBy(..., counting())` and take the maximum entry.
requirements: One `Pattern` with named groups for lines like `2026-11-20 14:03:22 INFO GET /api/users 200 35ms`.
Count lines per level, find the busiest minute and the slowest path; lines that do not match are counted as skipped.
stretch: Read the lines from a file with `Files.lines` and handle a million lines without loading them all.
